data.title: Amazon founder Bezos nears deal to buy stake in Liverpool
data.description: BENGALURU - A consortium ⁠that ⁠includes Amazon founder ​Jeff Bezos is close to agreeing a deal ​to acquire a stake ‌of about one-third in Premier League club Liverpool, multiple media outlets reported on Monday.

data.title: Embattled Infantino target of letter from three confederations
data.description: LAUSANNE — Fédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) president Gianni Infantino came under renewed fire on Monday as a joint letter from three confederations -- Union of European Football Associations (Uefa), Central America and Caribbean Association Football (Concacaf) and Asian Football Confederation (AFC) -- declared football "belongs to no individual".

data.title: Lionel Messi bids farewell to father who guided his glittering career
data.description: ROSARIO, Argentina - Argentina football icon Lionel Messi bid farewell on Sunday to his father Jorge, the global star's emotional anchor and agent since childhood who passed away following a battle with cancer aged 68.

data.title: Thai siblings strike gold, silver
data.description: Thailand's BMX riders delivered a statement of intent for the forthcoming Asian Games in Nagoya, with the Nakpaen brothers claiming gold and silver at the Asian Championships in Malaysia.

data.title: Chinese duo deny Aimsaard sisters Korea Masters glory
data.description: Women's doubles pair Benyapa Aimsaard and Nuntakarn Aimsaard missed out on their first title since July last year after losing in the final of the US$250,000 BWF Korea Masters on Sunday.

data.title: Spikers keep clean record in second leg
data.description: Thailand finished the second leg of the 2026 SEA V Cup in Chiang Mai with a perfect record after defeating Southeast Asian rivals Vietnam 3-0 (25-20, 25-10, 25-15) on Sunday.

data.title: War Elephants top the charts
data.description: Thailand secured top spot in Group B of the Asean Hyundai Cup on Saturday, beating Myanmar 2-0 in Bangkok to book a semi-final meeting with four-time champions Singapore.

data.title: ONE Championship: Masaaki Noiri promises Siasarani KO next after avenging Liu loss
data.description: Masaaki Noiri has promised to knock out Mohammad Siasarani in the ONE Samurai featherweight kickboxing tournament semi-finals before completing a route back to Superbon and the ONE Championship world title.

data.title: FIFA condemns 'concerted and ongoing effort' to weaken Infantino
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA on Saturday condemned "a concerted and ongoing effort by some to undermine" the world game's governing body and its president Gianni Infantino as the controversy over his now shelved private investment plan rumbles on.

data.title: Pattarapon seals first TDT victory in 3-way playoff
data.description: Pattarapon Losathapornpipit won the one-million-baht Singha–SAT TDT Nakhon Nayok 2026 in a three-way playoff at the par-71 Royal Hill Golf Resort & Spa in Nakhon Nayok on Friday.

data.title: Infantino denies allegations of affair, favouritism while at UEFA: report
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA president Gianni Infantino, who has endured a week of scathing criticism revolving around the now shelved private investment plan, has been accused by a British newspaper of paying off an alleged lover while at UEFA.

data.title: Arsenal sign midfielder Guimaraes from Newcastle
data.description: LONDON - Premier League champions Arsenal have completed the signing of Newcastle captain Bruno Guimaraes for a reported fee of £75 million ($101 million), the two clubs announced Saturday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nabil coach cries ‘robbery’ as Suakim admits ‘fluke’ knockdown
data.description: Nabil Anane’s coach Mehdi Zatout has branded the former champion’s split-decision loss to Suakim Pongsuphan PK a “robbery” – as the Thai veteran opened the door to a rematch.

data.title: ONE Championship: Superlek injury likely to derail Di Bella Tokyo title fight
data.description: Superlek Kiatmoo9’s October 17 world title fight with Jonathan Di Bella now appears highly unlikely to go ahead after his team confirmed the Thai star will need time away to treat the knee injury that ended his rematch with Abdulla Dayakaev.

data.title: Maradona’s ‘Hand of God’ ball on auction block
data.description: NEW YORK - The ball that Diego Maradona used to score his infamous “Hand of God” goal during Argentina’s win over England in the 1986 World Cup is expected to sell for $10 million at a US auction this month.

data.title: Embattled Fifa chief in Colombia for presidential inauguration
data.description: CALI, Colombia - Fifa president Gianni Infantino arrived on Friday in the Colombian city of Cali to attend hard-right president Abelardo de la Espriella's inauguration, as a crisis sweeps the highest echelons of the football world.

data.title: Howe exit leaves Magpies at crossroads
data.description: Of the many recent managerial changes in the Premier League, perhaps the biggest surprise was Eddie Howe stepping down at Newcastle United after a relatively successful five years as head coach. During that time the Magpies won their first trophy in many years and enjoyed several excursions into the Champions League.

data.title: Thammanoon returns to winning ways
data.description: The monthly CPF Boxing show staged by Petchyindee Promotions held its biggest event of the year in Bang Saen, Chon Buri, on Wednesday, with former two-division world champion Thammanoon Niyomtrong successfully returning to the winner's circle.

data.title: War Elephants on brink of last four
data.description: Thailand need only a draw to confirm their place in the semi-finals of the Asean Hyundai Cup 2026 as they take on Myanmar in the last match of Group B at Rajamangala National Stadium on Saturday night.

data.title: Embattled Fifa chief in Colombia for presidential inauguration
data.description: CALI, Colombia - Fifa president Gianni Infantino arrived on Friday in the Colombian city of Cali to attend hard-right president Abelardo de la Espriella's inauguration, as a crisis sweeps the highest echelons of the football world.

data.title: ONE Championship: Superlek finally returns to flyweight as Di Bella gets Samurai 4 wish
data.description: Superlek will return to flyweight for the first time in nearly three years to defend his ONE Championship kickboxing world title against Jonathan Di Bella in Tokyo.

data.title: South Africa coach Erasmus wary of struggling Argentina
data.description: BUENOS AIRES — South Africa head coach Rassie Erasmus insists the world champions face a "massive challenge" against Argentina on Saturday despite the recent poor form of their opponents.

data.title: SAT chief says U23s, spikers can deliver
data.description: Thailand's U23 football team will make a run into the later stages of the 20th Asian Games while the women's volleyball players will bring home a medal.

data.title: ONE Championship: Dayakaev makes weight with ease before tense Superlek face-off
data.description: Abdulla Dayakaev and Superlek both made weight for their ONE Championship rematch on Friday – before going chest to chest in a tense final face-off in Bangkok.

data.title: Hudson targets perfect finish
data.description: Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson believes having his players rested and fully fit after a tough away game against the Philippines will be crucial as the War Elephants prepare to take on Myanmar in the final Group B match of the Asean Hyundai Cup on Saturday.

data.title: UEFA says boycott of World Cups stands despite FIFA backdown on private investment
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - European football's governing body UEFA said they would maintain their boycott of the men's and women's World Cups on Thursday despite FIFA withdrawing the plan to open up their competitions to private investment.

data.title: Police raid South Korean FA as World Cup fallout continues
data.description: SEOUL - Police raided South Korea’s football association on Thursday as part of an investigation into the appointment of the coach in charge during their dismal World Cup campaign.
